description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the length of the gold prefix and BLEU score for two different wait policies, wait-1 and wait-9, representing consistency and inconsistency, respectively. The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale, ranges from 23 to 29, and has tick labels at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line with circle markers represents the "Consistency: wait-1" policy, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 25 at a gold prefix length of 0, decreasing to around 23.5 at a length of 3, and then increasing steadily to about 28.2 at a length of 20. The red solid line with square markers represents the "Inconsistency: wait-9" policy, starting at a BLEU score of around 25.2 at a gold prefix length of 0, fluctuating between 25 and 26 until a length of 10, and then remaining relatively stable around 25.2 until a length of 20.
